cases.question: Can I book a single 120-minute laser cutter reservation? I am an active adult member with current general safety orientation, recorded laser cutter induction, no other upcoming laser cutter booking, and closed-toe shoes.

answer.text:
The facts you provided do not meet all the required policy conditions.

Laser cutter: maximum 90 minutes per reservation, including setup and cleanup. [[E1]]

Members may hold only one upcoming laser cutter slot at a time. [[E2]]

3D printer: maximum 180 minutes per standard reservation, including setup and cleanup. [[E3]]

Jobs exceeding 180 minutes require advance written staff approval and a separate supervised schedule. [[E4]]

Back-to-back bookings to bypass either time limit are not permitted. [[E5]]

Cancel or reschedule in the Member Hub at least 2 hours before the start. [[E6]]

Machine-specific safety clearance is required before booking. [[E7]]

Members with approved extended-access credentials may enter certain common areas beyond desk hours; shared machine use still requires applicable supervision and booking rules. [[E8]]

An active adult membership is required to reserve equipment. [[E9]]

Members must check in using their own membership card and must not lend it to others. [[E10]]

Each active member may bring up to 2 guests per visit. [[E11]]

Guests may observe demonstrations but cannot operate the laser cutter, 3D printer, or other restricted equipment. [[E12]]

Guests under age 16 must also be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian. [[E13]]

All members must follow Workshop Safety Rules. [[E14]]

All new members must attend a 60-minute general safety orientation before entering work zones without a staff escort. [[E15]]

Before operating a laser cutter, 3D printer, or power tool, members must also pass the machine-specific induction and have the clearance recorded in the Member Hub. [[E16]]

Orientation must be refreshed every 12 months, or earlier after a serious safety incident or major equipment change. [[E17]]

Never use gloves near rotating machinery where entanglement is possible. [[E18]]

A first-time user may only operate a machine under direct staff supervision until the relevant induction is signed off. [[E19]]

Guests may observe but never operate restricted machinery. [[E20]]
